Heavy duty materials. Screws were too small for my comfort on the bunk mounts.. I drilled out the mounting holes and used some 3/8" x 1" stainless lag bolts. Mounted securely to my trailer. Pro tip: Install the u bolts and mounting brackets loosely on the trailer before installing the bunk supports. Leave them loose enough that you can still slide the bunk supports into them. Tighten the u-bolts evenly to keep the bunk aligned. It made mounting a breeze. Was able to do this by myself with this method.
